title: Exactly What to Say: The Magic Words for Influence and Impact
author: Phil M. Jones
target_audience: Anyone seeking to improve persuasive communication
People wishing to influence others more effectively in personal or professional situations
core_themes: The power of specific language in persuasion
The importance of intentional word choice
primary_purpose: To equip readers with simple, practical phrases—'magic words'—they can use to influence conversations, overcome resistance, and achieve greater impact in both business and everyday life.

structure_format.organization: Short chapters, each dedicated to a specific phrase or technique
features: Clear explanations of when and how to use each phrase

key_concepts_lessons: Small changes in phrasing can lead to bigger results in conversations.
Certain word patterns ('magic words') are proven to reduce resistance and create openness.
Asking better questions leads to more favorable outcomes.
Framing messages correctly makes people more receptive.
Sincerity and empathy are essential in persuasive communication.
Preparation increases confidence and impact in any interaction.
notable_features: 23 ‘magic phrases’ presented with context and rationale
Universal application across industries and scenarios
Digestible format for quick reference and review
cultural_historical_context: Published amid increased attention to soft skills and interpersonal communication in business, the book taps into modern needs for bite-sized, actionable strategies for persuasion in a fast-paced, skeptical world.
reception_impact: Popular among sales and business communities
Widely recommended as a pocket guide for sales staff and customer service teams
Praised for its succinct format and real-world usability
Seen as a complement to broader communication skills resources
comparable_titles: Influence: The Psychology of Persuasion by Robert B. Cialdini
To Sell Is Human by Daniel H. Pink
Words That Change Minds by Shelle Rose Charvet
Never Split the Difference by Chris Voss
